newsitem.title: USA: KN Energy to sell $100 mln captl securities.
newsitem.headline: KN Energy to sell $100 mln captl securities.

text.p: KN Energy Inc is expected to issue $100 million capital trust pass-through securities (TRuPS) sometime next week, market sources said on Friday.
The issue, managed via Salomon Brothers, will likely consist of forty-year debt, non-callable for 10 years.
Proceeds will be used to pay down short-term debt.

On Wednesday, Standard & Poor's rating agency lowered its rating on KN's preferred stock to BBB from BBB-plus. The agency cited the issuance of the TRuPS, which will result in total preferred stock outstanding increasing to about nine percent of total capital from under one percent.
KN's overall creditworthiness will not be diminished, however, according to S&P.
KN Energy, based in Lakewood, Colo, supplies natural gas to about 230,000 direct customers in Colorado, Kansas, Nebraska and Wyoming.
